name: Набери якомога більше очок (2)
description:
In this lesson, you have to capture the most valuable black piece. But be careful. If black takes your piece in return, you yourself will lose points. You don’t want that to happen! So, make sure black can’t capture your piece.


What do you have to do?

Earn the most points, but make sure you do not lose a piece of your own.

examples.text:
Do you remember the piece values?
Pawn = 1 point
Knight = 3 points
Bishop = 3 points
Rook = 5 points
Queen= 9 points
The queen (9 points) is worth more than the rook (5 points)
The rook (5 points) is worth more than the knight (3 points)

texts: Earn as many points as possible by capturing the highest-value piece.
